nodes.label: Classify the Issue Type
nodes.description: Analyze incident description and extract Object symptoms (Wizard App/Product Search, Object Access, Field Access)
nodes.name: Classify the Issue Type

nodes.label: Has Description contained 'Wizard App or Product Search Issue' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident mentions Wizard App or Product Search
nodes.name: Has Description contained 'Wizard App or Product Search Issue' Symptom?

nodes.label: Retrieve Contact Record
nodes.description: Query Contact record linked to the affected user and check Wizard_Country__c
nodes.name: Retrieve Contact Record

nodes.label: Is Wizard_Country__c Blank?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the Wizard_Country__c field on Contact is null or empty
nodes.name: Is Wizard_Country__c Blank?

nodes.label: Compare with Mirror User Contact
nodes.description: Retrieve mirror user Contact record to establish valid Wizard_Country__c baseline value
nodes.name: Compare with Mirror User Contact

nodes.label: Confirmed: Wizard_Country__c is blank
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: Contact Wizard_Country__c field is missing/blank, blocking Wizard App and Product Search
nodes.name: Confirmed: Wizard_Country__c is blank
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND Contact.Wizard_Country__c IS NULL OR Blank
nodes.decision_basis: Confirmed root cause: Contact Wizard_Country__c field is missing/blank, blocking Wizard App and Product Search

nodes.label: Has Description contained 'Object or Field Access Issue' Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident mentions Object Access or Field Access symptoms
nodes.name: Has Description contained 'Object or Field Access Issue' Symptom?

nodes.label: Is Object Access Issue?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the issue pertains to Object-level CRUD permissions
nodes.name: Is Object Access Issue?

nodes.label: Obtain Mirror User Details
nodes.description: Obtain mirror user details from ticket narrative or discover peer mirror user in same BU/Profile
nodes.name: Obtain Mirror User Details

nodes.label: Compare Profile, Permission Sets, and Object Permissions
nodes.description: Compare User Profile assignments, assigned Permission Sets, and ObjectPermissions against mirror user
nodes.name: Compare Profile, Permission Sets, and Object Permissions

nodes.label: Do Object Permissions Differ from Mirror User?
nodes.description: Evaluate if ObjectPermissions differ between affected user and mirror user
nodes.name: Do Object Permissions Differ from Mirror User?

nodes.label: Confirmed: Object Access Issue
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Object CRUD permissions on profile or permission sets (ObjectPermissions differ from mirror user)
nodes.name: Confirmed: Object Access Issue
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND ObjectPermissions differ from Mirror User
nodes.decision_basis: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Object CRUD permissions (PermissionsRead/Create/Edit/Delete) on profile or permission sets, differing from mirror user.

nodes.label: Is Field Access Issue?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the issue pertains to Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions
nodes.name: Is Field Access Issue?

nodes.label: Obtain Mirror User Details for Field Access
nodes.description: Obtain mirror user details to benchmark Field-Level Security
nodes.name: Obtain Mirror User Details for Field Access

nodes.label: Compare Profile, Permission Sets, and Field Permissions
nodes.description: Review Field-Level Security and compare field permissions against mirror user
nodes.name: Compare Profile, Permission Sets, and Field Permissions

nodes.label: Do Field Permissions Differ from Mirror User?
nodes.description: Evaluate if FieldPermissions (FLS) differ between affected user and mirror user
nodes.name: Do Field Permissions Differ from Mirror User?

nodes.label: Confirmed: Field Access Issue
nodes.description: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions (FieldPermissions differ from mirror user)
nodes.name: Confirmed: Field Access Issue
nodes.expected_criteria: User exists in NA Org AND IsActive = True AND FieldPermissions differ from Mirror User
nodes.decision_basis: Confirmed root cause: User lacks required Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions (PermissionsRead/Edit) on profile or permission sets, differing from mirror user.

nodes.label: Manual Review
nodes.description: Object issue investigation inconclusive. Route for L2 manual review.
nodes.name: Manual Review
nodes.expected_criteria: Object issue investigation inconclusive. Route for L2 manual review.
nodes.decision_basis: Object issue investigation inconclusive. Route for L2 manual review.

nodes.label: Out Of Scope
nodes.description: Incident symptoms do not match Object domain criteria. Escalate or reclassify.
nodes.name: Out Of Scope
nodes.expected_criteria: Incident symptoms do not match Object domain criteria. Escalate or reclassify.
